checks: Official pinned Safe 1.4.1 proxy and singleton bytecode, storage implementation pointer
Exactly five registered owners and threshold three
No enabled modules, guard or fallback handler
All configuration reads in one canonical block with two-RPC agreement
Runtime startup, NFT publication, Safe signing, commerce/delivery approval, live view and final broadcast require authority verification
limits: Configuration observed at the recorded block. Negative probes use copied responses, not live upgrades or module installations. All demo signers share one Mac; this does not provide independent custody. A pre-broadcast read cannot prevent a separate authorized Safe configuration change after broadcast and before mining.
